prompt: Write a program where the main entry point accepts command-line arguments and prints the first argument (after the program name) to the standard output, then exits. If no arguments are provided beyond the program name, the program should handle this case appropriately (either print nothing, print an error, or exit gracefully).
implementation_details: Language: C. Use the C language. Access the first command-line argument via argv[1]. Use the main function as the entry point with parameters int argc and char *argv[].
